info.name: Abstract API Avatars Website Screenshot API

params.name: api_key
params.description: Your unique API key for the Website Screenshot API.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the website to screenshot.

params.name: capture_full_page
params.description: Whether to capture the full scrollable page. Defaults to false.

params.name: width
params.description: Viewport width in pixels. Defaults to 1280.

params.name: height
params.description: Viewport height in pixels. Defaults to 720.

params.name: delay
params.description: Delay in milliseconds before taking the screenshot.

params.name: css_injection
params.description: CSS string to inject into the page before screenshotting.

params.name: export_format
params.description: Output format of the screenshot (jpeg or png). Defaults to jpeg.

items.docs: Capture a screenshot of any website URL with configurable viewport, delay, and CSS injection options.
